name: mern-microservices-app
description: Production-minded MERN microservices starter with React, Express, MongoDB, Docker, and CI/CD examples.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,auth,users,products,frontend -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue "npm run dev --workspace api-gateway" "npm run dev --workspace services/auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/user-service" "npm run dev --workspace services/product-service" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
